description:
Configure Wireshark to decrypt the HTTPS traffic in '~/Documents/captures/secure_api.pcap' using the session keys provided in '~/Documents/captures/session_keys.log'.

1. Open the PCAP file in Wireshark.
2. Go to Edit > Preferences > Protocols > TLS.
3. Set the '(Pre)-Master-Secret log filename' to the provided 'session_keys.log' file.
4. Analyze the decrypted HTTP traffic to find a response containing 'SECRET_FLAG:'.
5. Extract the UUID value following the label (e.g., if text is 'SECRET_FLAG: 1234-5678', extract '1234-5678').
6. Save ONLY the UUID to a file named '~/Documents/decrypted_flag.txt'.
